# Families chosen step by step

> Only a condition holding what stands before and after joins one step to the next, and continuity up to order replaces following position by position.

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

Where the family may change at each step (OneStep.StepRealized, with givers; OneStep.StepRunRealized, without), a sequence of patterns is shown by some world under no condition, under balance and under closure exactly when each step obeys its law (OneStep.step_every_iff, OneStep.step_balance_iff, OneStep.step_closed_iff, OneStep.stepRun_balance_iff): these conditions join no step to the next. Running down holds in its family everything standing before and after its step, and there a sequence is shown exactly when each step obeys its law and the passages continue up to order: at each positive level, as many stand there after a step as before the next (OneStep.Continues; OneStep.step_runsDown_iff, OneStep.step_runsDownClosed_iff, OneStep.stepRun_runsDown_iff, OneStep.stepRun_runsDownClosed_iff; OneStep.StepRealized.continues). Following position by position on one family gives continuity (OneStep.Chained.continues) and not conversely: a sequence of two idle conditions in swapped order runs down on families chosen step by step and on no single family (OneStep.steps_not_run), and a sequence shown under balance on chosen families is not shown under running down, its passages not continuing (OneStep.vanishing_steps). No premise.

Canonical source: [OneStep.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/OneStep.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- Continuity is derived only for conditions whose family holds what stands before and after the step (running down); conditions covering one side only are not treated.

P79b (work board, extending P79), following Ren's ‘move towards 100%’ of 12 October 2026, answering the next_delta of laws-of-one-step-complete. Reading (the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation): a family need not be fixed; chosen step by step, what joins one step to the next is only the continuity of what stands, not position. See the integration document §103.

The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 77 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run).
